phaseInterpretation.spawnToRunnerEnteredMs: Same-worker elapsed time from child spawn to entry after static imports; includes process scheduling and Node/module startup, not isolated module CPU time.
phaseInterpretation.startupGateWaitMs: Runner entry until storage readiness, measured in child monotonic time.
phaseInterpretation.runnerEnteredBeforeStorageReadyMs: Host storage-completion time minus child-entry time on the same worker; negative means imports finished after storage.
phaseInterpretation.launchToRunnerReadyMs: Host startRun selector until runner entry (baseline) or gate release observation (candidate), using same-worker wall origin and phase offsets.
phaseInterpretation.bootstrapStorageOverlapMs: Intersection of child spawn-to-entry interval with remaining host storage work. Overlapping durations must not be summed.

costs.enforcement: Each fixture worker role carried an unconditional IAM deny for bedrock:*, bedrock-mantle:*, and sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint*. The controller verified this before creating Sessions.
costs.infrastructureCostNote: Actual AWS billing was not measured. The planning ceiling is neither a bill nor an enforced AWS spending limit.

delegatedAnalysis.note: Delegate token usage and billing are not exposed by the available tools. No direct provider API calls were made for analysis.

limitations: Deterministic proxy replaces model inference; real-model startup was not remeasured.
One short environment-none workload; no checkout, tools, concurrent Sessions, browser rendering, or fleet percentile measurement.
Physical snapshot-cache residency, host scheduling, and network/storage variability remain uncontrolled.
Polling adds up to one interval plus request time to visible progress.
Post-completion journal-stop errors must be reported separately from zero failed measured Turns; deletion correlation is not proof of cause.

validation.narrowCandidateFullCheck: Architecture, schema, types, syntax and tests passed; packaging initially failed ENOSPC. All packaging, site and Terraform stages then passed at the same source commit.
validation.additionalPreflight: The second experiment initially stopped before creating any Sessions because its downloaded source archive exhausted disk. Retried with temporary files on an isolated RAM disk; no source or workload changed.
validation.logCollection: Followed CloudWatch nextForwardToken until unchanged, including empty intermediate pages; all 40 workers yielded their complete nine-event streams.

independentReviews.firstExperiment: No reliable improvement; supported by distribution, trace and provenance audit.
independentReviews.secondExperiment: No reliable improvement; independently checked statistics, joins, final ZIP SHA and all 62 entry hashes, sizes and Unix modes.

validation.restoredFullCheck: All stages passed at source commit 74eec3a. The normal-checkout command stopped at build for ENOSPC after architecture, generated contracts, types, syntax and tests passed. Packaging, site build and all Terraform format/validation stages then passed at the identical source commit in a temporary build checkout.
validation.restoredVerificationEnvironment: A preliminary run on a temporary HFS+ RAM filesystem failed 88 tests across 9 files with directory ancestry, sparse-file and dependency-resolution errors. It is not counted as a pass. All tests subsequently passed in the ordinary APFS worktree with installed dependencies and a protected local temporary directory. Only the remaining build and Terraform stages used a RAM-backed checkout to avoid disk exhaustion.

reproduction.note: The experimental runtime and comparison overlay remain available in these commits. They are absent from the final source tree.
